metadata.title: Public Communications

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Institutional Communications Management – ensures official communications representing the institution are authorized, consistent, and governance-aligned.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Public Communications – an architecture pattern governing systems that disseminate official messages to public or broad audiences.

props.name: data-domain
props.remarks: Communications and Messaging Data – includes public-facing messages, sender identities, campaign artifacts, and related records.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Digital Communication Technologies – platforms and services used to distribute messages to external or broad audiences.

links.remarks: Authoritative institutional source governing branding, sender identity, and official representation in public communications.

metadata.remarks: The Public Communications pattern defines governance obligations for systems that represent or communicate on behalf of the institution to public or broad audiences. It establishes authorization, branding, accountability, and assessability boundaries without prescribing messaging content or workflows.

components.title: Authorized Public Messaging
components.description: Ensures that only explicitly authorized roles, systems, and sender identities may issue public or institutional communications.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Abuse of valid accounts to issue unauthorized public communications.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Role-based access control and authorization of communication privileges.

components.title: Branding and Sender Identity Governance
components.description: Ensures that sender identities and branding used in public communications are reviewed, approved, and consistent with institutional standards.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Manipulation or misuse of branding or sender identity to misrepresent institutional authority.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Policy enforcement and governance review of branding and sender identity.

components.title: Reputational Risk Management
components.description: Affirms that public communications are subject to oversight to mitigate reputational, legal, and trust risks to the institution.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Erosion of institutional trust through misleading or inappropriate public messaging.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Governance oversight and policy compliance verification.

components.title: Auditable Public Communications
components.description: Ensures that public communications and sender authorizations are traceable and auditable for oversight and accountability.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Suppression or deletion of evidence related to public communications.
